sections.title: Inductive Sensors BES M12MI-PSC40B-S04G Order Code: BES0068

summaries.text: Datasheet providing dimensional schematics, general features, and electrical data for the Balluff BES M12MI-PSC40B-S04G inductive sensor. Details operating voltage, switching frequency, IP rating, ambient temperature limits, and functional safety parameters.
